decisions.reason: Because this citrus harvesting crate builds on our established reusable crate capabilities and remained visible after launch, we would keep it for now despite its narrower agricultural niche and moderate rationalisation risk.

Because the foldable large container is very close to our core engineering and manufacturing knowledge and kept a dedicated web presence across the observed years, we would continue it with low withdrawal risk.
Because a stackable plastic crate is central to our existing packaging competence and the early market evidence shows continued offering rather than a quick retreat, we would keep it.
Because the medium-duty rackable pallet fits our pallet platform knowledge and customer base well, we would retain it unless later sales evidence proved clearly disappointing.

Because the spill-retention pallet appears more peripheral to our core reusable logistics packaging focus and its web prominence weakened after launch, we would be more likely to discontinue it and reallocate resources.

Because the plastic pallet with load retainers is still closely related to our established pallet expertise and can be improved through in-house development, we would keep it despite some signs of more limited market emphasis.
